etix-fpx 0.4.2

- Reworked and clarified documentation in SKILL.md, detailing one-shot querying of Etix discovery data via the fpx CLI without needing the etix-mcp server.
- Instructions added for pairing and using the fpx CLI with the Transporter browser extension to bypass DataDome bot-wall.
- Outlined supported endpoints, call patterns, and exact usage recipes for querying events, venues, and performers.
- Explained error exit codes and troubleshooting steps for common issues.
- Clearly stated limitations: consumer-level, read-only access (no login or ticket purchasing); encrypted endpoints are not supported.
